trust_scope: Deterministic CPU fixture only. Candidate and schema-4 documents are fixed protocol evidence, not hardware observations.

fixed_candidates.msl-single: Archived P2 variant-b bytes (candidate prefix 1209a6d886) with a self-contained single-source delivery
fixed_candidates.msl-bundle: Archived P2 variant-a entries (candidate prefix 22c5880e60) packaged as an exact candidate envelope

publication_path: Each fixture run still passes experiments.common.conclusion_verdict and taic.portfolio_confirmation.verify_subject_document; no summary-only publication shortcut is used.
example: example-input.json + per-Track independent fixture runs + example-observations.json -> example-summary.json
path_sanitization: Only the temporary fixture root is replaced by <fixture>. Candidate/build/evaluation/confirmation/comparability/policy digests are not rewritten.
expected_winner: msl-bundle, latency_ratio 0.8 versus msl-single 0.9; exploration only
actual_confirmation: The two Tracks retain different freeze digests, confirmation seeds and fresh input identity digests despite common run/master seed and generator version. This is a fixed-shape example: input_sha256 is empty exactly as in production reports; derived_input_identity binds task pack, instance, case and seed instead of claiming a byte hash. A separate varlen-missing-digest negative remains fail-closed.
evaluation_cache: Each track×instance uses its own <run_dir>/cache; hit_count=0, miss_count=1, confirmation_cache_hit=false. cache_identity is protocol metadata, not a hardware observation.
exploration_bundle_digest: Computed from track_id + track_version + the ordered per-instance candidate identity vector, never from the vector alone.

cost.note: Scripted fixture costs, not a bill and not a performance measurement
